description: This class defines a Swing UI component for inputting stimulation parameters for a car engine simulation or control system, including ranges for RPM, engine load, coolant temperature, IAT, TPS, and EL resistance.

classes.name: StimulationInputs
classes.description: A Swing UI component that allows users to input engine stimulation parameters such as RPM range, engine load, sensor ranges, and EL resistance.

methods.name: StimulationInputs
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UI components and layout for engine stimulation inputs.

methods.name: getEngineLoadMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum engine load value selected by the user.

methods.name: getEngineLoadMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum engine load value selected by the user.

methods.name: getCltFrom
methods.description: Returns the starting coolant temperature (CLT) value.

methods.name: getCltTo
methods.description: Returns the ending coolant temperature (CLT) value.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main content JPanel of this UI component.

methods.name: getEngineLoadR2Resistance
methods.description: Returns the resistance value for engine load.

methods.name: getEngineLoadStep
methods.description: Returns the step size for engine load.
